hardware_fit.method: Two T3W1 hardware builds, `uv run --frozen xtask build firmware --model T3W1` in nix-shell. base = 1d21da9e4 content, bpq gated out (0 bpq symbols). fit = same tree plus a measurement-only, uncommitted patch lifting the emulator-only gate (166 bpq symbols). Stack from the hardware build's own arm-none-eabi-gcc command lines with -fstack-usage -fcallgraph-info=su (crypto/bpq/fit_compile.py, fit_stack.py); heap through the bpq_alloc seam (fit_heap.c). Reproduce: sh crypto/bpq/fit.sh.
hardware_fit.compile_for_arm: FAILS as committed: vendor/sphincsplus/ref/merkle.c:29 `info.wots_steps = steps;` assigns unsigned int * to uint32_t * (long unsigned int on arm-none-eabi; the same type on x86-64, so the emulator never saw it), -Werror. bpq_slh.c includes merkle.c for merkle_gen_root. The measurement lowered that one diagnostic to a warning (both 32-bit on Cortex-M33, code unchanged). The fix is open.
hardware_fit.flash: firmware.bin 2360320 B -> 2396672 B (+36352 B; text +36352, data and bss unchanged); FIRMWARE_MAXSIZE 3416064 B; FLASH 70.16 % used
hardware_fit.static_ram: none added: .data 512 B and .bss identical in both images; AUX1_RAM 100 % in both because the MicroPython GC heap takes the remainder (697904 B)
hardware_fit.heap: peak live bytes through bpq_alloc (= m_malloc_maybe on the device): bpq_sign 86160 B, bpq_public_keys 69794 B, bpq_verify 62400 B; largest single block 30720 B; 12.3 % of the 697904 B GC heap at peak. Allocation failure returns an error, not a crash.
hardware_fit.stack: 32 KiB app stack (.stack 0x8000). Worst static paths from the binding down: BpqGetCard (mod_trezorcrypto_bpq_public_keys) 16296 B, of which bpqmlk768_indcpa_keypair_derand (ML-KEM-768 keygen) is one 13832 B frame; BpqSign 6600 B; verify 6952 B. Complete for every reachable function, with three bounds named from source (SPHINCS+ thash VLA 2208 B, treehashx1 VLA 128 B, gen_leaf = wots_gen_leafx1). Not counted: libc leaves, the MicroPython allocator, and the MicroPython VM frames above the binding.
